changelog:
x-dm-auto-chat 1.0.0

- Initial release with full end-to-end X (Twitter) DM automation features.
- Scans DM inbox, identifies pending replies, reads conversation context, and sends persona-based responses.
- Supports searching for users and initiating new DM conversations.
- Includes E2E DM passcode unlock, DM permission checks, and rate control.
- Automatic browser and X account session detection with clear error handling.
- All actions operate within the user's authenticated browser, never bypassing access controls.
summary: X (Twitter) DM automated chat end-to-end Skill: scan DM inbox to identify pending-reply conversations, read message history, generate persona-based replies and send; also supports searching users and starting new conversations. Built-in E2E passcode unlock, DM permission filtering, and rate control.
